author: David Swanson
title: Abolish the Board of Peace. Try the Table of Peace.
content:
By David Swanson, World BEYOND War, September 5, 2026


I don’t mean to complain about the Board of Peace. If you want to ensure endless wars, expand settler colonialism, formally empower oligarchs over nations, destroy the United Nations, and keep genocides rolling along, I’m sure it’s fantastic!


But I recommend, at least in addition, trying the table of peace. This is something I tried in Charlottesville, Virginia, on Saturday. First, you’ll need a table. Then you’ll need some supplies. I recommend free stickers, bookmarks, and flyers, some books, some sign up sheets, some display boards, a jar for donations, a banner. Bring all this stuff and a few friendly people to a farmer’s market.


And you’ll need one more thing: a game. Here’s how I did that. I asked people to pretend to be the United States Congress for 10 seconds. (Many of them were disgusted at the thought but I assured them they could shower afterwards.) Then I gave them 12 stones and told them it was the federal discretionary budget for 2027. I asked them to distribute the stones in eight glasses labeled: Environmental Protection; Education; Labor, Small Business Administration, and Commerce; Health and Human Services; Housing and Urban Development, Interior, and Transportation; War and war preparations; Energy; and Other. If they asked “Now is this green energy or fossil fuel energy?” or “Is this education as it should be done or the dy$#@! they do now?” then I told them it was their ideal form of energy or education.


A lot of people played the game.


Environmental Protection won. Very close behind that were Education and Health and Human Services. Not far behind those was Energy, which everyone told me was renewable energy. Housing and Labor came next. And one gentleman the entire time I was tabling put one stone into War. He explained, almost apologetically, that it was for the “defensive wars.” I backed away slowly and kept my eyes on him.


When each person had finished distributing the stones, I showed them a pie chart illustrating the budget proposed for 2027 by Trump. The glass that people had left almost empty eats up 77.66% of the pie. The categories people wanted funded most get the tiniest slivers.


Not everybody will play the game. Some people will take a sticker and keep walking without slowing down. Some people will stop and talk. Others will buy a book, sign a pledge, etc. With the ones who will devote 60 seconds or more, your goal is of course to get them engaged. Will they sign up and get involved? Will they take some flyers to distribute? Here, I think, it’s important to understand that success is measured in very small numbers. If you can get a few people doing more than they were before, that’s a win.


Many people, those who don’t slow down and those who stop to chat, will assure you that all is fine because they plan to vote in an election. I live in a district and state and nation with no anti-war candidates running for any offices, but even if that were not the case, the delusion that voting fixes everything and that no one can do anything other than voting would still be by far the single biggest hurdle to effective participation in society.


Many will tell you how deeply they agree regarding war and peace, and how sorry they are that all is hopeless and doomed by “human nature,” or “sociopaths,” or “money” — they’ve got a million of these. Others will thank you for what you’re doing — conveying the meaning that they’re glad you’re doing it so that they don’t have to.


But there’s usually a few percent who will actually get active and educate and agitate and demonstrate. Get them, and you’ll have done your part toward finding that few percent of the whole population that is needed to change the world.


The post

Abolish the Board of Peace. Try the Table of Peace.

 appeared first on

World BEYOND War

.

title: good fucking lord we need to demystify minerals. crystals do not have healing or magical powers you…
content:
wolfennracha-deactivated2024062:

good fucking lord we need to demystify minerals. crystals do not have healing or magical powers you guys are just getting scammed

and we are what exactly? everything we interact with is a jigsaw puzzle of atoms. everything that effects or heals us in made of atoms and vibrations. negative ions from moving water affect our mood so why wouldn’t crystals?

I own a rock shop. A lady came in about three years ago and asked me which crystals are best for healing, I gently explained that they didn’t have powers or healing properties. She started crying. She had late-stage cancer and no medical treatments were working. A crystal-healer had told her the only thing that would save her were crystals, then proceeded to convince her to spend $2000 on what realistically was only maybe $50 worth of Arkansas Quartz. She had two months to live, and was being strung along by scammers who gave her false hope in exchange for her life savings. I had indirectly just told this woman she was going to die, and it was hitting her all at once. Unfortunately, stuff like this is a regular occurrence. Maybe that’s my worst story, but it’s something I encounter on a weekly basis at least. Rocks, Minerals, and crystals are cool as hell but they don’t have powers. They aren’t mystical or special. I’m sorry for going off on a rant about this but it’s frustrating and it can ruin people’s lives.

author: Unknown
title: Tullio Masotti - Den italienska syndikalistkongressen
content:
Författare

: Tullio Masotti

Titel

: Den italienska syndikalistkongressen

Källa

: Tidningen Brand #4 1911


 Den märkvärdiga företeelsen av en politisk syndikalism är en fullständigt italiensk skapelse. Intet annat land i världen känner till något dylikt. Och att tänka sig, att den parlamentariska syndikalismen anklagar oss för att vilja gå i den franska revolutionära syndikalismens fotspår! Om jag inte misstar mig, så ha fransmännen aldrig drömt om en syndikalism, som lever utanför fackföreningarna. Och ännu mindre om en partisyndikalism, som nödtvunget leder till att handla inom den lagliga borgerlighetens och statens råmärken. Å andra sidan sysselsätter sig den italienska socialdemokratien livligt med att studera andra länders revolutionära rörelser. Eftersom den är mycket praktisk och mycket förståndig - alla medelmåttiga och demokratiska saker äro alltid ytterst förståndiga - lever den på formaliteter och släcker sin törst med hyckleri och lögner.


 I Italien har syndikaliströrelsen en alldeles särskild karaktär, som skiljer den från andra länders. Detta av två skäl. För det första: då de ekonomiska förutsättningarna för en fri utveckling av det syndikala medvetandet fattas hos arbetsklassen, har syndikalismen kommit till genom tidskrifter och tidningar; för det andra: de, som ha formulerat det ekonomiska programmet och förut deltagit i det socialistiska partiets politiska rörelse, de hade partimännens hjärnor, för vilka det är nästan omöjligt att fatta att de icke skulle ha någon rätt över arbetarklassen och i fackföreningarna. Dessa, fackföreningarna, äro ju dock en sammanslutning av likställda producerande och böra själva kunna svara för sina behov och för det, som tarvas för arbetarna.


 Detta grundfel asltrar den tvetydiga företeelse, som bär namnet den politiska syndikalismen, och som är något helt annat än syndikatets ekonomiska syndikalism. På den kongress, som i slutet av förra året hölls i Bologna, utbröt den oförsonliga konflikten mellan de båda riktningarna: syndikat-syndikalisterna och de politiska.


 En av frågorna på kongressen var bildandet av politiska syndikalistgrupper och en sammanslutning av sådana över hela landet.


 Tre riktningar framträdde i denna fråga. Den första ville göra dessa grupper till valorganisationer; den andra ville inskränka deras uppgift till att göra propaganda för arbetsförbundets utveckling; den tredje slutligen ansåg dessa grupper onödiga och skadliga vad deras syfte än var. Denna sista riktning lät uppsluka sig av diskussionen och smalt samman med riktningen numro två, som gick segrande ur striden.


 Striden stod således klar och tydlig mellan anhängarna av deltagandet i val och motståndarna därtill.


 Den italienska syndikalismen var förut egentligen endast ett namn. Den måste få kongressens absolution och en ny döpelse för att veta, om den var något annat, än de andra demokratiska och socialistiska partierna, eller om den kunde smälta ihop med dem.


 Kongressen i Bologna medförde det resultatet, att den efter tre dagars livliga debatter bestämde syndikalismens grundlinjer. Arbetarriktningen segrade fullständigt över gruppfrågorna och deltagande-i-val-taktiken.


 Följande resolutioner fattades:


 »Kongressen beslutar att vända sig till alla kamrater för att på alla platser, där det är möjligt, bilda syndikalistiska föreningar, som icke sätta sig emot organisationerna men ha till mål att genomsyra dem genom alla former av propaganda med andan och innehållet i våra idéer».


 Kongressen beslutar att bilda en landsorganisation av dessa grupper, vilken icke bör sammanblandas med de gamla partierna, som upphöjt sig till förmyndare över proletariatet för att exploatera dess styrka till förmån för sina politiska syften. Denna landsorganisation skall stödja de olika gruppernas arbete, jämnställa den dugliga verksamheten, teckna de allmänna linjer som böra följas i alla företag, och beflita sig om att genom direkt arbete bidraga till massans socialistiska uppfostran. Den syndikalistiska landsorganisationen, som icke vill vara ett parti som söker triumfen på den politiska-sociala arenan, kan icke uppträda som politisk organisation, emedan det vore att uppmana proletariatet att sätta förtroende till en politisk grupp, under det att syndikalisterna endast i sitt förbund se den makt, som kan besegra kapitalismen och som har möjlighet att förverkliga arbetets frigörelse.

author: M.P
title: Dos nuevas querellas contra Luis Hermosilla: tráfico de influencias, cohecho y obstrucción a la justicia en caso Luchsinger Mackay
content:
En la última semana de agosto del 2026, el abogado Luis Hermosilla fue notificado por el 7º Juzgado de Garantía de Santiago de dos querellas en su contra que fueron declaradas admisibles. La primera presentada por José Tralcal Coche y su abogada Karina Riquelme y la segunda presentada por Luis Tralcal Quidel y su abogado Sebastián Saavedra, para investigar su responsabilidad en delitos que impidieron un debido proceso en este mediatizado caso.

“Necesitamos que se rechace la nulidad del caso Luchsinger”, escribió por chat el abogado Luis Hermosilla, entonces Asesor del Ministerio del Interior del Gobierno de Piñera al también abogado y asesor de la cartera José Ramón Correa, actual accionista de Azul Azul. Hermosilla consultó explícitamente por “amigos” en la sala penal que revisaba el recurso de nulidad interpuesto por Luis y José Tralcal, declarados culpables en el caso Luchsinger Mackay, argumentando que “un cuarto juicio sería fatal”. Estos chats revelados por el medio Reportea en junio del 2026, dieron paso a dos querellas presentadas en contra de Hermosilla, declaradas admisibles por el 7º Juzgado de Garantía de Santiago. Desde junio del 2018 José Tralcal Coche, Luis Tralcal Quidel y José Peralino cumplen sentencias por ser declarados culpables de incendio con resultado de muerte en el caso Luchsinger Mackay, cuya principal prueba se basa en una declaración inculpatoria dada por José Peralino Huinca. Quien denunció las torturas que sufrió por parte de los policías para que firmara lo que él calificó como “puras mentiras”. No obstante, el juicio y la condena siguieron adelante, pese a la querella por apremios ilegítimos que Peralino interpuso en contra de los funcionarios de la PDI, la que fue desestimada por el Ministerio Público.

“Todas las pruebas ofrecidas por las defensas que acreditaban la inocencia de los condenados, fueron duramente atacadas por el Ministerio Público, no sólo en estrados, sino también fuera del proceso. Las camareras del motel en que

pasó la noche el día de los hechos Luis Tralcal Quidel, fueron detenidas y el local allanado. Se acusó a los defensores de presentar pruebas falsas y fueron objeto de persecución policial”, señala una editorial del Centro de Investigación y Defensa Sur, CIDSUR publicada en octubre del 2018. Estas son solo algunas de las múltiples irregularidades que organizaciones de derechos humanos han observado en el transcurso de este caso. Para el abogado Sebastián Saavedra, presidente de CIDSUR, “el caso Luchsinger Mackay es un caso clásico de cómo opera la razón de Estado, donde el debido proceso cede frente a las presiones gubernamentales y a los poderes fácticos como son la gente de poder en la región de La Araucanía”.

Cabe recordar que en el Caso Luchsinger Mackay se realizaron tres juicios orales: el primero, en 2014, en contra del Machi Celestino Córdova; el segundo, en 2017, en contra de la Machi Francisca Linconao, Luis Tralcal, José Tralcal y otras ocho personas mapuche; en primera instancia, fueron todos absueltos, pero la sentencia fue anulada por la Corte de Apelaciones de Temuco. Finalmente, en 2018, un tercer juicio oral condenó a Luis Tralcal y José Tralcal a 18 años de cárcel y José Peralino a 5 años de libertad vigilada.

Para el abogado Saavedra, “esta situación es completamente anómala, porque cuando se trata de un comunero mapuche que ha resultado herido o muerto, jamás ha existido este grado de persecución”. Por el contrario, señala que cuando los imputados son personas mapuche, la persecución de los responsables se centra principalmente en los autores materiales, “jamás en personas que hayan planificado o hayan tenido algún otro tipo de participación. Con procesos rápidos y, en su mayoría, penas bajísimas para los autores de los hechos”.

Faltas al debido proceso en el ojo internacional Si se acreditan los delitos de tráfico de influencias por parte de Luis Hermosilla y quienes resulten responsables, las penas llegan hasta los 5 años, lo mismo para el delito de cohecho. En cuanto a la obstrucción a la justicia las penas podrían llegar hasta los 540 días.

Pero más allá de esto, Saavedra señala que, de obtenerse una sentencia condenatoria, “impactaría en la condena que ya ha sido dictada en el caso Luchsinger Mackay, toda vez que implicaría un reconocimiento expreso a la falta de imparcialidad del tribunal y una falta grave al debido proceso y, evidentemente, buscaríamos la anulación de la sentencia”.

author: rezgar2
title: La promesse du Rojava et la dissolution des FDS : le temps est-il venu pour la gauche de repenser la question kurde ?
content:
Kurdish residents in Syria celebrate election of self-government officials, January 2014


Critiquer les FDS n’est donc pas critiquer les droits des Kurdes ; critiquer les partis au pouvoir dans la Région du Kurdistan n’est pas critiquer la cause kurde ; et rejeter l’État-nation n’est pas rejeter l’identité nationale ni les droits nationaux. C’est un plaidoyer en faveur d’une alternative de gauche et humaniste qui dépasse le nationalisme excluant pour aller vers un État de citoyenneté démocratique, la justice sociale et un horizon socialiste.


Author


Rezgar Akrawi


    Submitted by

rezgar2

 on September 4, 2026


La promesse du Rojava et la dissolution des FDS : le temps est-il venu pour la gauche de repenser la question kurde ?


Un plaidoyer pour un État de citoyenneté démocratique, la justice sociale et un horizon socialiste.


Rezgar Akrawi


Le Palais du Peuple : la fin d'une expérience et le commencement d'une nouvelle question


Le 25 août 2026,

Mazloum Abdi a annoncé depuis le Palais du Peuple à Damas

 que la mission des

Forces démocratiques syriennes (FDS)

 avait pris fin et qu'elles se dissolvaient en tant que force militaire autonome, en même temps que l'Administration autonome (

Rojava

) et les formations militaires et civiles qui lui étaient rattachées, toutes absorbées dans les institutions de l'État syrien.


Cette annonce faisait suite à la vaste opération militaire lancée par les forces gouvernementales en janvier 2026, qui a coûté aux FDS de larges portions du territoire qu'elles contrôlaient et a ouvert la voie à des négociations conclues par

un accord d'intégration de leurs forces et de leurs institutions à l'État syrien

.


Je considère cette évolution comme positive, car elle réduit la probabilité de guerres nationalistes dévastatrices dont les premières victimes sont toujours les travailleurs et les travailleurs pauvres de toutes les nationalités. Pourtant, si les accords successifs, de mars 2025 à l'accord global de janvier 2026 puis à l'annonce de la dissolution, ont bel et bien abaissé le risque de guerre et épargné aux habitants de la région de nouvelles destructions, ils ne comportaient aucune disposition sur les questions pour lesquelles nous luttons en tant que forces de gauche et progressistes : les droits des femmes, le caractère laïque de l'État, la fin des privatisations, la protection du secteur public, les garanties des droits des travailleuses et des travailleurs, la réalisation de la justice sociale et des élections démocratiques à tous les échelons du pouvoir.


Le modèle qu'une large partie de la gauche kurde et internationale a présenté pendant des années comme une révolution de gauche, sociale, féministe et démocratique venue de la base s'est achevé par une décision prise au sommet et annoncée depuis un palais présidentiel à Damas, sans référendum populaire et sans décision déclarée des conseils et des communes que les FDS avaient présentés au monde comme les instances censées exercer la souveraineté populaire au sein de ce que l'on appelait l'« Administration autonome », censée reposer sur le pouvoir du peuple.


Les États-Unis, principal soutien militaire et politique des FDS tout en appuyant simultanément la trajectoire politique et militaire des nouvelles autorités de Damas, ont été une partie centrale dans la conduite du cours de la guerre, puis dans celui de son règlement. Ce seul fait révèle où se situait réellement le pouvoir de décision tout au long de cette période et quel crédit peut être accordé à un pari sur les grandes puissances impérialistes.


Ce qui frappe, c'est la répartition des coûts. Le nouvel État a absorbé une partie de l'élite militaire et partisane des FDS, en dépit du caractère de classe, religieux et autoritaire du nouvel ordre politique. Plusieurs commandants des FDS ont été nommés à des postes militaires, d'autres ont reçu des grades et des fonctions administratives, et ils sont devenus une composante active de l'appareil militaire, politique, administratif et sécuritaire du gouvernement syrien, ainsi que de sa structure de classe capitaliste. Pendant ce temps, les travailleurs, qu'ils soient kurdes, arabes, syriaques ou d'autres communautés, sont restés confrontés aux mêmes problèmes sociaux, économiques et politiques qu'avant la guerre, aggravés par des années de conflit et de destruction.

title: Certain Days: The 2027 Freedom for Political Prisoners Calendar — Our Duty to Win
content:
Now in its 26th year of publication, the Certain Days: Freedom for Political Prisoners Calendar is required reading for radicals, leftists, and all who support political prisoners and advocate the end of mass incarceration. 


Order at

https://burningbooks.com/products/certain-days-the-2027-freedom-for-political-prisoners-calendar-pre-order


All proceeds support prisoners and grassroots organizations like Release Aging People in Prison (RAPP), Mutulu Shakur legal support, Sundiata Acoli release fund, Palestinian Youth Movement, Puget Sound Prisoner Support, Coalition to Decarcerate Illinois, Appalachians Against Pipelines, Community Resource Initiative- CA, P4W Memorial Collective Prisoners’ Justice Day healing circle, Wet’suwet’en Solidarity Fund, Cascadia Forest Defenders and NorCal Resist.


Each calendar has 11 thought-provoking essays and 12 pieces of beautiful art. You’ll feel inspired every day of the year, with radical historical dates and lots of space for your own plans.  


Featuring


Anna Bee • Bänoo Zan  • Coordinadora Anarquista Tejiendo Libertad • Dani Kriatura  • David Gilbert • Tiger Eye Gemini • Epigmenio Gomez & Annabelle Heckler • JP Werline • Kimberly Cox-Marshall • Kwaneta Harris • Leo Rose Rodriguez • Luisa Tapetillo • Mica • MJ Hammond • Prison Banned Books Week • Nicole Rose • Oso Blanco • Rhys • Rick Ayers • Ruby • Ruby Reyes • Solidarity Apothecary • Winsor Kinkade • Xinachtli


ABOUT CERTAIN DAYS

The Certain Days: Freedom for Political Prisoners Calendar is a joint fundraising and educational project between outside organizers across North America and current and former political prisoners, including currently imprisoned Xinachtli (s/n Alvaro Luna Hernandez) in Texas. We were happy to welcome founding members Herman Bell and Robert Seth Hayes (Rest in Power) home from prison in 2018, and David Gilbert in 2021, each of whom spent over forty years behind bars. All of the current members of the outside collective are grounded in day-to-day organizing work other than the calendar, on issues ranging from legal aid to community media, radical education to prisoner solidarity. We work from an anti-imperialist, anti-racist, anti- capitalist, feminist, queer- and trans-liberationist position.

All proceeds from the calendar go to abolitionist organizations working for a better world

.

author: albatross
title: Their Wars, Our Dead!
content:
Anarchist reflections on anti-militarism since the invasion of Ukraine. Edited by Alex Alder and Bill Beech. Published in 2025 by Active Distribution.

from the Editorial by Alex Alder and Bill Beech

To resist militarism, we must draw the lines of struggle not against enemy nations and their armies but against the interconnected systems of power that dominate us all, beginning with 'our own' rulers and bosses.

This book brings together six anarchist responses to war and militarism. Since the invasion of Ukraine in 2022, a war fever has swept the anarchist movement and a large section of the left. The essays collected in this book seek to learn from the past in order to put forward a revolutionary yet realistic course of anarchist anti-militarism today.

Some of the topics included are: Internationalist opposition to WWI and WWII; the mechanics of imperialist politics; conscription (and resistance to it) in Ukraine, Russia, and Israel; anti-militarist responses to the war in Ukraine; the complex relationship between anarchism and militarism in Ireland.

- Introduction - Alex Alder and Bill Beech - Defeatism in more senses than one - Declan McCormick - Conscription in the current and coming wars - Andrew Żywności - By the skin of our teeth: the Troubles, militarism and anarchists in Ireland - Jason Brannigan, Organise! - IWA - British anarchist opposition to the Second World War - Jasmine Lloyd

author: Julius Gavroche
title: For Tony Gatlif (1948-2026)
content:
I took up the cinema which can tell about the others, about those who have no right of voice and are unable to speak. This kind of cinema is not aimed at tempting or diverting somebody from the world.


Tony Gatlif (from an interview for the Ukranian newspaper

The Day

)


I don’t believe art changes reality, … That was never the case. What art can do is scratch a memory – and that’s important.


Amos Gitai,

The Guardian

, 04/09/2026


Tony Gatlif (whose real name is Michel Dahmani) was born on September 10, 1948, in the suburbs of Algiers to a family of Andalusian Roma. He discovered cinema during his all-too-brief years at school, as he spent most of his time on the streets. He was illiterate and a budding delinquent, but his memories of the movies never left him. At the age of twelve, to avoid an arranged marriage, he left for Algiers. He distanced himself from his family and worked as a shoeshine boy. He spent his early childhood there until the early 1960s.


Tony Gatlif recounts his memories of his youth:


“There were nearly 500 of us children. We lived in the streets, free. We hated school, its fences, its benches. We didn’t want to be locked up. So the authorities threatened to stop paying family allowances to those who didn’t send their children to school. They failed. Next, they tried a different approach, offering milk and flour to diligent students. Another failure. It was the schoolteacher who found the solution. He bought a 16mm projector, enrolled the school in the Jean Vigo film club, and every week screened a film that served as the basis for the lessons. That’s how I learned about film. I owe my entire career to this teacher, who confessed to me a few years ago that he had supported the FLN at the time.”


(Source: website

tonygatlif.free.fr

, dedicated to the life and work of Tony Gatlif)


“Music is something vital. Without it, I believe I would be unable to exist, and this has been the case since I was a very young child. Without constituting a religion in the slightest, it represents the only true link between the dead and the living; it carries joy, pain, melancholy, and love to the peaks of emotion.”


(Source: website

tonygatlif.free.fr

, dedicated to the life and work of Tony Gatlif)


“Music is about sensations, and sensations come first. It’s the soul of the characters… I don’t express myself at all with photos, with visions.”


Tony Gatlif,

Libération

, 04/09/2026


“I have experienced war, I saw people having their throats slit in the vineyards. It was disgusting and I had nightmares about it. I did not see humanity there. Maybe that conditioned my life as a filmmaker. When you make films, the first thing you have to do is make movies for ordinary people. We are not ‘stars’ and we have no interest in being ‘stars’. We make films because we love the people who love movies. It’s a source of pride to us that people go to our films and get to know us. The people who call themselves ‘stars’ are idiots,” Gatlif said in an interview with

www.objectifgard.com

.


(Source:

romea.cz

)


Tony Gatlif,

Canta Gitano/Corre Gitano

 (1981)


Tony Gatlif,

Latcho Drom/Safe Journey

 (1993)


Tony Gatlif,

Gadjo Dilo/The Crazy Stranger

 (1997)


Tony Gatlif,

Vengo

 (2000)


Tony Gatlif,

Transylvania

 (2006)


I will only find peace of mind when I stop making films. When you have peace of mind, you do not need to make films, and cinema will drop away as an unnecessary thing. Can you fancy making a film if you feel inner peace? Nothing is taking place. I could just film a tree all day and night or watch clouds for hours on end. And the audience? It needs feelings, conflicts, and contradictions. All this runs counter to inner peace.


Tony Gatlif (from an interview for the Ukranian newspaper

The Day

)


Suggested Reading:


Mehdi Benallal, “L’art libertaire de Tony Gatlif”,

Le Monde diplomatique: les blogs

, 23/02/2010

title: Le collectif d'hacktivistes « Autistici/Inventati », inscrit sur la liste des organisations terroristes par les États-Unis
content:
Depuis 25 ans, « Autistici/Inventati » héberge une série de services numériques, tels que des boîtes mail non commerciales (@autistici.org, @inventati.org), des listes de diffusion utilisées par des collectifs, des associations et des centres sociaux, ainsi que des blogs d'information ou de communication gérés par des milliers d'entités (noblogs). Le mercredi 26 août 2026, nous avons appris que le gouvernement des États-Unis avait décidé d'inscrire ce petit collectif de bénévoles et de militants numériques italiens sur la liste des organisations terroristes mondiales passibles de sanctions.


Voici le communiqué du collectif Autistici/Inventati :

https://cavallette.noblogs.org/2026/08/10076


DÉCLARATION DU COLLECTIF A/I SUR LES SANCTIONS IMPOSÉES PAR LE GOUVERNEMENT AMÉRICAIN À SON ÉGARD


Nous avons appris aujourd'hui que le gouvernement des États-Unis a décidé d'inscrire un petit collectif de bénévoles et de militants numériques italiens sur la liste des organisations terroristes mondiales passibles de sanctions, comme on peut le lire dans les déclarations du Département du Trésor, dans celles du Département d'État et dans le décret exécutif correspondant.


Nous rejetons catégoriquement toutes les accusations formulées dans ces déclarations et, dans le même temps, nous réaffirmons avec force notre engagement à fournir une plateforme d'outils d'autodéfense numérique afin de permettre aux militant·e·s, aux particuliers, aux groupes et aux associations de communiquer librement.


Nous ne nous arrêterons pas et continuerons à faire ce que nous avons toujours fait, en nous opposant par tous les moyens aux fausses accusations montées de toutes pièces par une administration politiquement désespérée dont le seul but est de détourner l'attention des gens et des médias de sa propre violence et de son désir de guerre.


L'antifascisme et l'anticapitalisme ne sont pas du terrorisme. Manifester n'est pas du terrorisme. Et tout le monde a le droit de prendre la parole et de lutter pour l'humanité tout entière.


Collettivo Autistici / Inventati — “Socializzare saperi senza fondare poteri”


Stay human


Communiqué de Free All Antifas - Italie :

https://freeallantifas.noblogs.org/attacco-al-collettivo-autistici-inventati/


ATTAQUE CONTRE LE COLLECTIF « AUTISTICI/INVENTATI »


Le 26 août, le gouvernement des États-Unis a inscrit « Autistici/Inventati » sur la liste des « Specially Designated Global Terrorists », en application du décret présidentiel n° 13224, le désignant comme une organisation terroriste mondiale.


Une décision qui s'inscrit dans la continuité de la politique de l'administration Trump, qui avait déjà désigné Antifa comme organisation terroriste en 2025. L'invention de cette prétendue organisation est un stratagème visant à créer un ennemi intérieur, afin de délégitimer la dissidence et de criminaliser l'antifascisme.


Dans ce contexte, A/I est également visé, en tant que nœud technologique utilisé par les réseaux antifascistes, qui offre des outils d'autodéfense numérique et de libre communication. Outre A/I, Palestine Action et Masar Badil ont également été visés.


Il ne s'agit pas d'un épisode isolé. Du procès de Budapest aux poursuites contre les antifascistes, en passant par les recours au mandat d'arrêt européen et la fermeture de certains comptes bancaires de la caisse de solidarité Rote Hilfe, nous observons différents dispositifs qui produisent le même effet : délégitimer l'antifascisme et criminaliser la dissidence.


Le fil rouge qui les relie est la tentative d'isoler celles et ceux qui luttent, de s'attaquer aux outils d'organisation et de briser les liens de solidarité.


C'est pourquoi le soutien et la défense d'Autistici/Inventati nous concernent toutes et tous. Défendre les espaces autonomes de communication et de dissidence, c'est défendre la possibilité de construire la solidarité.

title: Ο πρύτανης ΕΜΠ σε ρόλο κατηγόρου, δικαστή και εκτελεστή
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Ο πρύτανης ΕΜΠ σε ρόλο κατηγόρου, δικαστή και εκτελεστή


Πόσο απόλυτα ανεξέλεγκτη καθίσταται η εξουσία ενός πρύτανη, με βάση το νομικό πλαίσιο επιθετικής αποδημοκρατικοποίησης των ΑΕΙ που έχει κατασκευάσει η κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη;


Η καταγγελία προπτυχιακών, μεταπτυχιακών και υποψήφιων διδακτόρων του Εθνικού Μετσόβειου Πολυτεχνείου σχηματίζει μια εικόνα με διαπλεκόμενους ευνοούμενους της πρυτανικής αρχής που χρησιμοποιούνται ως «μάρτυρες» – και, μάλιστα, με ψευδείς καταθέσεις – εναντίον υποψήφιου διδάκτορα ο οποίος είχε ήδη στοχοποιηθεί προσωπικά από τον πρύτανη, Ιωάννη Χατζηγεωργίου με μήνυση του τελευταίου για τα γεγονότα της

«Βραδιάς του Ερευνητή» το 2024

.


Ακολουθεί το κείμενο της καταγγελίας:


Η πρυτανική αρχή του ΕΜΠ προχωρά στην κατασκευή πειθαρχικής δίωξης-σκευωρίας προς πολιτικά ενεργό Υποψήφιο Διδάκτορα του ΕΜΠ.


Την Δευτέρα 7/9, στις 17:00, ο υποψήφιος διδάκτορας Αρχιτεκτονικής του ΕΜΠ καλείται σε ακρόαση στο πειθαρχικό συμβούλιο για τρία διαφορετικά περιστατικά που αναφέρονται στην πολιτική του δράση τα προηγούμενα χρόνια. Το πειθαρχικό συμβούλιο θα διεξαχθεί ηλεκτρονικά και “κεκλεισμένων των θυρών”, ενώ παρότι ο υποψήφιος διδάκτορας έχει αιτηθεί αναβολή λόγω πρόσφατης αλλαγής του δικηγόρου του, αυτή δεν του έχει δοθεί, αφήνοντας ανοιχτή την πιθανότητα να διεξαχθεί η διαδικασία χωρίς τον απαραίτητο χρόνο ώστε να προετοιμαστεί η υπεράσπιση. Οι ποινές που αντιμετωπίζει ο υποψήφιος διδάκτορας φτάνουν μέχρι και την οριστική του διαγραφή. 


Τα δύο από τα τρία περιστατικά βασίζονται σε δικαστικές υποθέσεις για τις οποίες δεν έχει ξεκινήσει καν η δίκη, ενώ το τρίτο σε μια αναφορά φύλακα του κτηρίου Αβέρωφ.  Είναι αξιοσημείωτο ότι ένα από τα περιστατικά που βαραίνουν τον υποψήφιο διδάκτορα βασίζεται σε μήνυση που έχει καταθέσει ο πρύτανης ΕΜΠ για την συγκέντρωση στη “Βραδιά του Ερευνητή” το 2024, ο ίδιος πρύτανης που θα παρίσταται στο πειθαρχικό συμβούλιο. Πως νομιμοποιείται – τόσο τυπικά όσο και ηθικά – μια διαδικασία στην οποία δικαστής και μηνυτής συμπίπτουν; Στα υπόλοιπα περιστατικά, πρωταγωνιστούν η ιδιοκτήκτρια κυλικείου Γεωργία Τύρου και ο φύλακας του κτηρίου Αβέρωφ Γιώργος Τσουνιάς. Διάφορα στοιχεία, τα οποία παρατίθενται στο βίντεο και στην σχετική ανακοίνωση του σωματείου των ερευνητών, μπορούν να οδηγήσουν στο συμπέρασμα ότι τα εν λόγω άτομα αποτελούν “ευνοούμενους” του πρύτανη.


Το παρόν βίντεο εντάσσει την υπόθεση αυτή στο γενικότερο πλαίσιο της. 


Απέναντι στην καταστολή και στις σκευωρίες, απαντάμε με αλληλεγγύη και συλλογική αντίσταση!


Στις 7 Σεπτεμβρίου, συγκεντρωνόμαστε στις 17.00 έξω από την Πρυτανεία για να σταματήσουμε το πειθαρχικό – παρωδία!


Προπτυχιακοί – Μεταπτυχιακές – Υποψήφιοι Διδάκτορες ΕΜΠ


Η ανακοίνωση του Πανελλαδικού Σωματείου Εργαζομένων στην Έρευνα και την Τριτοβάθμια Εκπαίδευση:

https://unionresearchers.wordpress.com/2026/09/02/καλεσμα-σε-συγκεντρωση-εναντια-στην-π/

title: Barrack: Yaptırım kararı Türkiye’ye yönelik değil
content:
ABD Hazine Bakanlığı’na bağlı Yabancı Varlıkları Kontrol Ofisi (OFAC), Türkiye merkezli Golden Global Yatırım Bankası ile iştirakleri Golden Global Varlık Kiralama ve Golden Global Portföy Yönetimi’ni 4 Eylül’de yaptırım listesine aldı.


Bakanlık, üç kuruluşun İran Devrim Muhafızları Ordusu’na bağlı Kudüs Gücü adına para transferlerine aracılık ettiğini ve İran bağlantılı finansal işlemleri kolaylaştırdığını öne sürdü.


Yaptırım kararının ardından ABD’nin Ankara Büyükelçisi Tom Barrack, X sosyal medya hesabından açıklama yaptı.


Barrack, “Bu yaptırım tek bir kurumun faaliyetlerine yöneliktir. Bir ülkeye, bir bankacılık sistemine ya da bir müttefike değil” dedi.


Süreç boyunca ABD Hazine Bakanlığı ile Türkiye’deki muhataplarının “doğrudan ve sürekli temas halinde” olduğunu belirten Barrack, şunları kaydetti:


Türk makamları, rahatsızlık verici bir açıklamayı hakaret olarak görmek yerine, bu meseleyle ilgili belirsizlikleri açıklığa kavuşturmak ve bundan sonra şeffaflığı güçlendirecek bir süreci başlatmak üzere temas kurdu.

–Tom Barrack


“Türkiye şeffaflığı güçlendirecek bir süreç başlattı”


Barrack’ın açıklamasına göre Türkiye makamları, yaptırım kararına konu olan meseledeki belirsizlikleri açıklığa kavuşturmak ve şeffaflığı güçlendirmek amacıyla ABD makamlarıyla temas kurdu.


Türkiye’nin yaklaşımını “egemen bir ortağın” tutumu olarak nitelendiren Barrack, Ankara’nın konuyu “zamanında ve uygun bir soruşturmayla” ele alacağını söyledi.


Barrack’ın sözünü ettiği inceleme ya da sürece ilişkin henüz resmi bir açıklama yapılmadı.


*ABD Ankara Büyükelçisi Tom Barrack. (Fotoğraf: Anadolu Ajansı)


Banka iddiaları reddetti


Golden Global Yatırım Bankası ise yaptırım kararının ardından yaptığı açıklamada ABD Hazine Bakanlığı’nın iddialarını reddetti.


Banka, OFAC kararında adı geçen kişi ve kuruluşların müşterisi olmadığını, bu taraflarla doğrudan ya da dolaylı herhangi bir işlem yapmadığını açıkladı. Yaptırım kararına karşı Türkiye’de ve uluslararası alanda itiraz ve hukuki başvuru haklarını kullanacağını da bildirdi.


Golden Global, kuruluşundan bu yana yerel ve uluslararası bankacılık kuralları ile uyum yükümlülüklerini yerine getirdiğini ve paydaşlarına karşı yükümlülüklerini karşılayacak mali güce sahip olduğunu da belirtti.


Golden Global hakkında


Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu (BDDK), 16 Mayıs 2019’da Emir Kaya, Salih Berberoğlu, Recep Kaba, Ahmet Dağlı ve Mustafa Akın’a 150 milyon TL sermayeyle Golden Global Yatırım Bankası’nı kurma izni verdi. Banka 15 Ekim 2019’da kuruldu ve 1 Haziran 2020’de faaliyetlerine başladı.


Banka, kendi kurumsal tanıtımında ağırlıklı olarak dış ticaret şirketlerine bankacılık hizmetleri ve alternatif finansman sağladığını, faaliyetlerini faizsiz finans ilkelerine göre yürüttüğünü belirtiyor.


Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu’ndaki (KAP) güncel ortaklık yapısına göre bankanın yüzde 53,98’i Emir Kaya’ya, yüzde 32’si Salih Berberoğlu’na, yüzde 14’ü Recep Kaba’ya ait. Abdurrahman Topcu ve Emre Dağlı’nın ise yüzde 0,01’er payı bulunuyor. Bankanın ödenmiş sermayesi 1 milyar 650 milyon TL.


Yaptırım listesine alınan Golden Global Varlık Kiralama ile Golden Global Portföy Yönetimi de bankanın bağlı ortaklıkları arasında yer alıyor.


(VC)

title: Le point de bascule
content:
Salut,


Ce texte, c'est un coup de gueule, a moitié né du déséspoir, et a une autre moitié d'un profond besoin d'une bascule, radicale, brutale et... violente.


Gino va très certainement être extradé en Allemagne. Et de là-bas, probablement ensuite en Hongrie. Et il lui arrivera des trucs... pas cool. Qu'est-ce que les dangereux mouvements d'extrème-gauche de cette région du monde font pour l'en empêcher

 

? Des rassemblements et des banderoles. Pas forcément que ça, mais on est sur cet ordre là, principalement. Qui ici pense que cela suffira

 

? Comme pour Maja. Comme pour toustes les autres. Fût une époque... on l'aurait libéré. Par une évasion de prison ou par une attaque de son convoi.


De partout dans ce pays de merde, des squats sont sur le point d'être expulsés, remettant des dizaines voir des centaines de personnes à la rue, dans la misère, la chaleur, ou suivant la saison, dans le froid. La rue tue qu'on dit. Oui. La rue tue. Et on est toujours incapables d'empêcher cela. Incapables de défendre les squats. Pourtant, on a été capables de les défendre par le passé. De les faire reculer, de les faire partir. D'être suffisamment menaçant·es pour qu'ils ne viennent même pas nous en sortir. Ou à défaut, de les accueillir avec des... dispositifs, qui ne les laisseraient pas ressortir indemnes.


Récemment un patron d'entreprise à foncé en camion sur des grévistes, et il est ressorti du poste de police quelques heures plus tard, fanfaronnant. Il n'y a pas si longtemps, on était tout à fait capables de leur faire peur aux patrons. On était capables de les exproprier. De leur faire accepter toutes nos demandes. On était même capables de les rendre hors d'état de nuire définitivement. N'est-ce pas monsieur le

PDG

 de Renault

 

?


Pendant qu'ils nous exploitent, nous humilient, nous brisent, nous empoisonnent, et nous tuent... Pendant ce temps-là, la peste brune se fait toujours plus pressante et visible. Eux, ils sont prêts pour la guerre civile. Nous pour l'instant, on est juste prêt·es à aller à l'abattoir faire nos 3x8, et ce jusqu'à ce que ça soit notre tour.


Si c'est pas votre meilleur rêve d'avenir, va falloir, au moins, commencer à y réflechir.

author: Radikal Perspektif
title: Kitlesel Anarşizm
content:
Yazan: Gorthim


PDF Linki


Bu yazı,

yazarın Substack’inde

 daha önce yayınlanmıştı

.


Bir Kavramlaştırma Önerisi


Anarşizmin eğilimlerini kümelendirmek her zaman sorun teşkil etmiştir. Genellikle birçok tanım iç içe geçer ve pek işe yarar tanımlar ortaya çıkmaz. Bu sorun, birçok farklı yönden anarşistlere zarar vermiştir: soyut tanımlar nedeniyle herkesin anarşist sayılması, pratikte birleşmiş birçok ekolün ayrılması, anarşizmi çalışmayı zorlaştırması ve geleneği yakalamanın zorlaşması.

1


“Komünist” dediğinizde hem Goldman’ı hem Guerin’i hem de Galleani’yi kastedersiniz. Bu üç isim de aslında tamamen farklı temellere sahip bir komünizm savunmuşlardır. Ekonomik inşa bazlı bir tanım bundan dolayı sıkıntılıdır. Sendikalistler dediğimizde ise birçok farklı temelden sendikalistle karşılaşırız: Varlin bir proudhonyendi, Pouget bir komünistti ve Pestana bir reformistti. Yine örgütlenme ekseniyle tartışma da bu sebeple sorunludur. Genellikle kullandığımız kümeler, birçok önemli ismi keyfi bir şekilde dışarıda bırakır. Bunlara “sadece anarşist” demek de yine çok fazla farklı görüşleri bir arada tutar ve genel bir eğilim tespit etmeyi imkansız hale getirir. En sağlıklı mevcut görüş, büyük ihtimalle birçok farklı eğilimi birlikte ele alarak, bir düşünürü tanımlamaktır. Emma Goldman’a bakarsak: bireyci, feminist ve komünistti. Bence bu daha isabetli bir yaklaşım ama aynı zamanda sorunu çözmüyor. Goldman’ın bu yaklaşımları sentezleme biçimi bir eğilimdir. Peki bu eğilim neden oluşmuştur? Bu pek tartışılmıyor bence.


Ben anarşizmi toptan tanımlamaya veya bazı anarşist sayılan ekol veya isimlerin neden anarşist sayılmaması gerektiği tartışmasına girmeyeceğim. Amacım, benim anarşist gelenek içinde gördüğüm ve kendimi ait hissettiğim eğilimi, bu hatalara düşmeden tanımlamak. Ben bu eğilime 

“Kitlesel Anarşizm”

 diyorum. Bu kelime yerine bazen “liberter gelenek” veya “anarşist gelenek” kullandığım oldu. Bu isimlendirmenin daha açıklayıcı olduğuna ikna oldum.


Benim görebildiğim kadarıyla, bu isimlendirme ilk defa Lucien van der Walt ve Michael Schmidt tarafından yazılan 

Black Flame

 kitabında geçmiş. Kitlesel anarşizm

2

 ve isyancı anarşizm burada iki farklı strateji olarak ele alınıyor ve bir karşıtlık kabul ediliyor. Benim, onların kitlesel anarşizm kavrayışında katılmadığım iki nokta var: (1) stratejik tercihlerden ibaret görmüyorum ve (2) isyancı anarşizmi karşısına koymayı eksik buluyorum.

3

 Kitlesel anarşizm, sadece kitlelerle devrimin geleceğini kabul etmek ve onların içinde faaliyet göstermek değildir. Teorik temel olarak da ayrılır. Felipe Correa’nın 

Bandeira Negra

 isimli anarşist kuram çalışması da benim kavrayışımda etkili oldu fakat Correa’nın anarşizmi fazla monolitik aldığını düşünüyorum. Kitabındaki anarşizm tanımının daha çok kitlesel anarşizmi anlattığını düşünüyorum.

Yola çıkış şeklimi anladığınıza göre, tanımın temellerine geçebiliriz.


Tanımın Temelleri


1. Negatif İnşa ve Pozitif İnşa


Anarşist kuramın, sadece negatif tanımlarla (otorite karşıtlığı veya devlet karşıtlığı) tanımlanması tartışmalı bir konudur. Buna girmeyeceğim. Fakat, herhangi bir anarşist eğilimin tanımlanabilmesi için, onun pozitif (yapıcı) görüşlerini de içermelidir. Burada egoist ve nihilist ekol, pozitif bir inşayı bilinçli bir şekilde reddettiği için bir istisna sayılabilir.

4

 Fakat, benim tanımlamak istediğim Kitlesel Anarşizm, bu iki ekolü de içermemektedir.


Birinci Kriter:


Anarşist ekollerin, hem yıkıcı hem de yapıcı tahayyülleri, tanıma yansımalıdır.


2. Toplumsal Hareketler ve Tarihsel Yaklaşım


Sorunlu eğilimleri daha önce tartışmıştım: tarih dışı yaklaşım ve büyük düşünürler yaklaşımı. Anarşizm, tarihsel bir şekilde ele alınmalı ve toplumsal hareketlerden ayrı değerlendirilmemelidir.


E.P. Thompson’ın “Aşağıdan Tarih” anlayışı hem kuramsal olarak anarşizm ile uyumludur hem de anarşizmi çalışmak için çok faydalı bir yaklaşımdır. Anarşist örgütler genellikle kitleler tarafından kurulur ve yönetilir. Bu sebepledir ki Mançurya Devrimi’nde veya Yeni Zelanda’daki sendikalist harekette karizmatik liderler üzerinden bir hareketi çalışmayı alışkanlık haline getiren Batılı akademi, bu konular üzerinde genellikle sessiz kalmıştır. Halk hareketleri içinde anarşizm somutlaşır. Örnek vermek gerekirse, sendikalizmi anarşizmden ayırarak, anarşizmi çalışmak mümkün değildir.


O halde ikinci kriter:

title: Vê hefteyê di biamag kurdiyê de
content:
biamaga kurdî a vê hefteyê ango a hefteya yekem bi edîtoriya Aren Yildirim û Ferhat Yaşar amade bû. biamaga kurdî vê hefteyê cih daye xebat û lêkolînên li ser mijarên rojnamegeriya aştîparêz, muzîk, huner, zanist, ziman, tenduristî, wêje û helbestê. 


Ev naveroka berfireh a ku di hefteya destpêkê de tê pêşkêşkirin, hewl dide ku pîvanên rojnamegeriya mafparêz bi analîzên li ser çand, huner û muzîkê re bike yek. Bi zêdekirina nivîsên di qadên zanist û tenduristiyê de, biamag kurdî çarçoveya xwe ya weşanê ji sînorên rojeva siyasî derbas dike û ber bi hilberîna zanîna piralî ve dibe. 


Ji aliyekî ve teorî û pratîka rojnamegeriya mafparêz dixe navenda nîqaşê, ji aliyê din ve jî bi rêya xebatên li ser zanist, tenduristî û zimannasiyê hewl dide ku valahiya di weşangeriya kurdî de bi metnên kûr û resen dagire.


Aren Yildirim

di nivîsa xwe de behsa rojnamageriya bianet kurdiyê û avabûna biamag kurdiyê dike. 


Ozgur Amed

 li ser pirtûka

James Morris Blaut

 a bi navê "Modela Cîhanê ya Mêtingeran" (Sömürgeciliğin Dünya Modeli-Dergah Yayın.) nivîsiye. Amed di nivîsê de hewl dide bide nîşandan ku têgeha "navend-Ewropa" efsaneyeke ava-kirî ye û divê em dîroka cîhanê ne ji çavê mêtingeran, di çarçoveya wekheviya civakan û rastiya kolonyalîzmê de bixwînin.


Dilşah Kaymaz

ê nivîseke bi sernavê “Hêz û sînora dengê jinê” nivîsiye ku balê dikişîne ser dengbêjiya jinan a li hemberî sansura patriyarkal û zextên civakî.


Ayşenur Ozel

ê li ser veguhezbariya nîkelatan nivîsiye ku behsa xebitîn û taybetmendiyên superveguhêzbaran dike.


Mirad Bayram

 di nivîsa xwe ya bi sernava

Di medyaya Kurdî de tecrubeya “Rojnamegeriya Aştîparêz”

 de behsa ezmûn û astengiyên di medyaya kurdî de li pêş rojnamegeriya aştîparêze, dike.


Siya Robin

 bi nirxandineke kûr çûye nav cîhana helbestên Kamiran Alî Bedirxan. Bi vê lêkolîna xwe ya têr û tijî, nirxandineke gelekî hêja û berz diyarî xwendevanan kiriye.


Mehmet Erbey

 behsa serpêhatiya ger û geşta xwe ya li Dersîmê kiriye.


Sami Tan

 nivîsek li ser kurdî nivîsiye ku behsa rewşa kurdî û nakokî û dubendîyên siyasî yên li pêş kurdî dibe asteng dike.


Eser Çetin

di nivîsa xwe de


ji bo tenduristiyê bandor û zirara germahiya zêde ya li Ewropayê nirxandiye.


Pêşniyara guhdarkirinê

title: Δυναμικές αντικυβερνητικές διαδηλώσεις ενόψει ΔΕΘ, το Σάββατο 5/9, στις 18.00
content:
Το Σάββατο 5/9 στις 18:00, ενόψει των εγκαινίων της 90ης ΔΕΘ, συνδικάτα, εργατικά σωματεία, φοιτητικοί σύλλογοι, οργανώσεις και συλλογικότητες από όλη τη χώρα καλούν σε μαζικές συγκεντρώσεις στο κέντρο της πόλης, για να διαδηλώσουν με κεντρικό σύνθημα τους αγώνες για ζωή, ελευθερία και αξιοπρέπεια, ενάντια στον εργασιακό μεσαίωνα, στην κοινωνική – οικονομική εξαθλίωση, τους πολέμους και τις δολοφονικές πολιτικές του καπιταλιστικού συστήματος.


Τα κύρια αιτήματα των κινητοποιήσεων είναι η κατάργηση των αντεργατικών νόμων, η θέσπιση συλλογικών συμβάσεων εργασίας με αξιοπρεπείς μισθούς, το τέλος στον πληθωρισμό, στην ανασφάλεια και στην στεγαστική κρίση, αλλά και η παύση κάθε συμμετοχής του ελληνικού κράτους στη γενοκτονία των παλαιστινίων και στις νέες πολεμικές καμπάνιες και συμφωνίες με το Ισραήλ και το ΝΑΤΟ.


Τα καλέσματα λαμβάνουν χώρα σε τέσσερις διαφορετικές τοποθεσίες στο κέντρο της πόλης: Στην Καμάρα όπου καλούν πρωτοβάθμια σωματεία, ταξικές και φοιτητικές πρωτοβουλίες, οργανώσεις και συλλογικότητες. Στο Άγαλμα Βενιζέλου καλούν οι ΓΣΕΕ, ΑΔΕΔΥ και το Εργατοϋπαλληλικό Κέντρο Θεσσαλονίκης. Στην πλατεία ΧΑΝΘ (17.30) το ΠΑΜΕ. Στην Εγνατία και Αγία Σοφία η ΟΚΔΕ.


Παράλληλα σωματεία και εργατικές πρωτοβουλίες οργανώνουν μετακινήσεις από διάφορα σημεία της χώρας με λεωφορεία, με σκοπό την διευκόλυνση στη μεταφορά των διαδηλωτών στη Θεσσαλονίκη ενόψει των κινητοποιήσεων. Παρακάτω ακολουθούν τα ραντεβού των μετακινήσεων ανά πόλη και αναλυτικά τα καλέσματα των διαδηλώσεων.

title: RitardaTav: quando i treni non sono mai in orario, dal 2033 si passa al 2035
content:
Il tempo passa ma le vecchie abitudini restano. Se c’è un 

punto fermo

 nella costruzione della 

Torino-Lione

 è sicuramente che non si può mai dire — nemmeno per scherzo — che i cantieri siano un 

esempio di puntualità ed efficienza

. La grande piaga che ci portiamo appresso da 

trent’anni

 continua infatti con i suoi 

ritardi cronici

.


da

Notav.info


​È recente la notizia che la Torino-Lione rischi di accumulare altri 

due anni di ritardo

. In questo modo, l’entrata in funzione della grande opera sarebbe spostata al 

2035

, contro il 

2033

 di cui si parlava solo qualche mese fa, già allora con disappunto.


​A preoccupare è soprattutto 

l’avanzamento dello scavo sul versante francese

. Anche perchè su quello italiano 

manco è iniziato

, quindi tanto vale concentrarsi su qualcosa che seppur lentamente, si muove.


​Con la sua media di 

90 centimetri di scavo al giorno

 contro i 

12 metri previsti

(a tutti capita di fare degli errorini di calcolo però fa davvero ridere), la talpa 

Viviana

 inizia a preoccupare (intendiamoci, non noi). Vorremmo dire che è agosto per tutti, anche per le TBM, ma la verità è che 

sta scavando 90 cm al giorno ormai da un anno

, salvo quel periodo di pausa meritato tra maggio e giugno. Oltretutto, 

infiltrazioni di acqua

 e caratteristiche geologiche della roccia costringono spesso a ricorrere allo 

scavo tradizionale

 che risulta ovviamente molto ma molto più lento. Se possiamo aggiungere, anche se non ci pare che importi molto, è un 

metodo decisamente più rischioso

.


​

TELT

 ovviamente ci rassicura del fatto che i problemi di “Vivi” fossero previsti e messi ben in conto, che la sua lentezza 

non comprometterà l’avanzamento complessivo

 e 

Manuela Rocca

, direttrice aggiunta della società, ha sottolineato che le difficoltà geologiche incontrate lungo il percorso erano ampiamente previste. Non abbiamo capito se il suo fosse un modo di fare autoironia, ma poco importa.


​L’affermazione risulta tuttavia un po’ strana perchè a meno che Viviana non diventi potentissima e scavi di colpo tutto l’ammanco di metri, viene da chiedersi come sia possibile che non ci siano ritardi. Ma d’altronde chi siamo noi per mettere in discussione un metodo che 

ha già costato trent’anni di ritardi

. Effettivamente ci troviamo di fronte a dei professionisti del caso e non a degli impreparati che stanno ancora rodando il metodo. D’altronde lo capiamo anche, sul lavoro perdere tempo sempre.


​Tuttavia, la posizione dei tecnici francesi (

COI

, il consiglio d’orientation des infrastructures) risulta in 

forte contrasto con la linea politica

 ribadita anche da Parigi e evidenzia una 

forte divergenza

 tra le valutazioni del comitato e l’andamento effettivo delle opere. Oltre ai problemi geologici già sopra citati, si pone un’altra questione: all’apertura del tunnel la Francia utilizzerà la 

linea storica ammodernata Dijon-Modane

, che al momento risulta in grado di assorbire solo 

due terzi della capacità merci prevista

 (

16,8 milioni di tonnellate

 contro le 

25 programmate

). Tuttavia, si vocifera che i lavori per le nuove linee d’accesso francesi potrebbero partire 

soltanto dopo il 2040

. Senza questa parte, chiaramente, la Torino-Lione 

non sarà operativa

. Quindi, questi grandi pagliacci che se la suonano e se la cantano, come al solito stanno prendendo in giro chi ancora li ascolta.


​Facendo due calcoli su Viviana, sappiamo che ad oggi ha scavato 

250 metri su un percorso totale di 9 km

. Tenendo conto che l’inizio dei lavori è avvenuto a settembre 2025, in questo anno ha completato 

meno del 3%

 del tratto previsto. Mancano insomma circa 

8.750 metri

 alla fine del suo percorso. Al ritmo attuale servirebbero circa 

9.722 giorni

 (più di 

28 anni

 insomma). Parliamo ovviamente di un dato indicativo, basato su calcoli aritmetici, che non tiene conto della complessità dell’opera ma vuole dare un’idea della 

peggiore delle ipotesi possibile

. (Peggiore per loro).


​Fa sorridere pensare ad uno scenario del genere, nell’ottica che, come ben sappiamo, la Torino-Lione parte già come 

un’opera manchevole

 che anche se venisse realizzata domani, sarebbe comunque ormai 

obsoleta e inefficiente

. Figuriamoci tra altri trent’anni quale scempio e barzelletta sarebbe.


​Al momento sono attivi 

11 cantieri

 tra Francia e Italia e finora sono stati scavati poco più di 

49 chilometri di gallerie sui 164 complessivi

, circa il 

30% …

title: Νίκος Μαζιώτης: Αποφυλακίζομαι με λήξη ποινής
content:
Σαν σήμερα, στις 2 Σεπτέμβρη του 2009 είναι η επέτειος μιας από τις σημαντικότερες ενέργειες του Επαναστατικού Αγώνα και γενικά του εγχώριου αντάρτικου πόλης, η επίθεση με αυτοκίνητο-βόμβα με 150 κιλά εκρηκτικά ΑΝFΟ εναντίον του Χρηματιστηρίου Αθηνών.

Ήταν τότε που ο Επαναστατικός Αγώνας μιλούσε για την κρίση, από το 2005 πριν αυτή ξεσπάσει στις ΗΠΑ και πριν ακόμα αυτή πλήξει τη χώρα το 2009-2010. Όταν μιλούσε για τα μνημόνια πριν ακόμα αυτά επιβληθούν. Όταν μιλούσε για την ευκαιρία τότε μιας συστημικής ανατροπής και επανάστασης που δυστυχώς δεν πραγματοποιήθηκε.

Στις 5 Σεπτεμβρίου 2003 είναι η επέτειος που ξεκίνησε τη δράση του ο Επαναστατικός Αγώνας με τη διπλή βομβιστική επίθεση στα δικαστήρια της Ευελπίδων στην Αθήνα.

Σε λίγες μέρες, στις 14 Σεπτεμβρίου αποφυλακίζομαι με λήξη ποινής, έχοντας εκτίσει με 14 χρόνια παραμονής στη φυλακή συν 6 χρόνια εργασία, το σύνολο των 20 ετών κάθειρξης, ποινή στην οποία έχω καταδικαστεί για τη δράση του Επαναστατικού Αγώνα.

Σε μια εποχή που αλλάζουν αλλεπάλληλα οι ποινικοί και οι «σωφρονιστικοί» κώδικες, αυξάνοντας τα όρια των ποινών και του πραγματικού χρόνου έκτισης των ποινών, ακόμα και με παράνομες αλχημείες όσον αφορά την αναδρομική ισχύ των νόμων, όταν διαχρονικά η κύρια προτεραιότητα του κράτους είναι η αντιμετώπιση των πολιτικών του αντιπάλων, είμαι ο πρώτος κρατούμενος των ελληνικών φυλακών και ο πρώτος πολιτικός κρατούμενος με 20ετή ποινή πρόσκαιρης κάθειρξης που εκτίει το σύνολο της ποινής του, χωρίς αναστολή, όπως συνήθως γινόταν μέχρι τώρα. Αυτή η εξέλιξη είναι το αποτέλεσμα του ότι τα δικαστικά συμβούλια της Λαμίας έχουν απορρίψει 7 φορές την υφ’ όρον αποφυλάκισή μου, με το σκεπτικό ότι δεν έχω «σωφρονιστεί», δεν έχω «βελτιωθεί» ηθικά και ότι αρνούμαι να αναγνωρίσω ως εγκληματική τη δράση του Επαναστατικού Αγώνα.

Πράγματι έχουν δίκιο! Σε κάποια ακρόαση του δικαστικού συμβουλίου, σε ερώτηση αν έχω «σωφρονιστεί», απάντησα ότι ούτε σε 1.000.000 χρόνια δεν θα γίνει αυτό. Αρνούμαι λοιπόν να υιοθετήσω την «ηθική» τους, την ηθική της υποταγής, ούτε φυσικά έχω αναθεωρήσει για τη δράση του Επαναστατικού Αγώνα, η οποία ήταν επωφελής και αναγκαία για την κοινωνική πλειοψηφία, τον λαό και το προλεταριάτο, αφού στρεφόταν εναντίον του εγκληματικού κρατικο-καπιταλιστικού συστήματος εξουσίας.

Ιδιαίτερα μέσα στις σημερινές συνθήκες όπου το σύστημα γίνεται όλο και πιο άγριο, καταδικάζοντάς μας ισόβια στη δουλεία του χρέους, καταδικάζοντάς μας στη φτώχεια και την εξαθλίωση, εξοντώνοντας λαούς και πληθυσμούς πλεονάζοντες για το ίδιο με τους πολέμους, τις γενοκτονίες και τις πολιτικές διάσωσής του, και σκοτώνοντας αργά αλλά σταθερά τον πλανήτη που ζούμε προς χάρη του κέρδους και της εξουσίας μιας αισχρής μειοψηφίας. Μέσα σ’ αυτές τις συνθήκες ο αγώνας εναντίον του Κράτους και του κεφαλαίου όχι μόνο είναι δίκαιος αλλά και αναγκαίος και επιβεβλημένος. Δεν θα άλλαζα στο παραμικρό τις πολιτικές-αγωνιστικές επιλογές μου, ακόμα κι αν γύριζα τον χρόνο πίσω.

Αυτή η εξέλιξη της έκτισης του συνόλου της ποινής, έχει και τη θετική της πλευρά, αφού δεν θα έχω καν περιοριστικούς όρους, δηλαδή δεν θα δίνω παρόν στο αστυνομικό τμήμα της περιοχής που θα διαμένω.

Ευχαριστώ μέσα από την καρδιά μου, όλα τα συντρόφια, όλες και όλους που στάθηκαν αλληλέγγυες/αλληλέγγυοι με οποιονδήποτε τρόπο όλα αυτά τα χρόνια μ’ εμάς τα μέλη του Επαναστατικού Αγώνα, που παραμείναμε συνεπείς στις επιλογές αγώνα που κάναμε.

ΚΑΜΙΑ ΑΝΑΘΕΩΡΗΣΗ – ΚΑΜΙΑ ΜΕΤΑΝΟΙΑ

ΤΙΜΗ ΓΙΑ ΠΑΝΤΑ ΣΤΟΝ ΣΥΝΤΡΟΦΟ ΛΑΜΠΡΟ ΦΟΥΝΤΑ

author: Kimberly Mabaso
title: Papers, Please: Canon Collins 2026 Essay Shortlisted Finalist
content:
This piece was a shortlisted finalist for the

Canon Collins 2026 essay competition

. The annual competition invites essays that demonstrate thought leadership and offer fresh perspectives on issues affecting southern Africa.


Some of my earliest memories are not of places but of words.


One of those words was

kwerekwere

.


I heard it long before I understood it. It drifted through school corridors and playground conversations, sometimes wrapped in laughter, sometimes sharpened into an insult. As a child, I knew nothing about immigration policies, borders or xenophobia. I only knew that whenever the word was directed at me, it carried a message that was impossible to misunderstand, it said to me “you are not one of us”.


I was two years old when my family moved from Zimbabwe to South Africa. South Africa is where I learned to read and write, where I made friends, where I attended school and imagined a future for myself. It is the country whose streets, accents and seasons shaped my understanding of the world. It is, for all practical purposes, home. Yet there were moments growing up when none of that seemed to matter as much as the place printed on a birth certificate. The older I became, the more I realised that borders do not always exist where we think they do. We imagine borders as fences, checkpoints and lines drawn across maps, but the most enduring borders are often invisible. They appear in conversations. They reveal themselves in assumptions. They emerge when someone asks where you are really from, as though your first answer could not possibly be enough. They surface whenever a person is reduced to their nationality before they are recognised as a human being.


My earliest encounter with this reality came when I was six years old. Xenophobic violence had erupted in parts of South Africa. Years later, newspapers would describe the attacks in terms of immigration, politics and public unrest. My memory is much simpler. I remember sleeping at the beach with my family because it felt safer than sleeping at home. I remember the uneasiness of the adults around me and the strange awareness that something had changed, even if I could not yet understand what it was. Children rarely understand the reasons behind fear, they simply absorb it. Looking back, what unsettles me most is not the violence itself but the ideas that made it possible. Violence does not begin with burning shops or broken windows. By the time those things happen, something deeper has already taken root. It begins in the stories people tell about who belongs and who does not. It grows whenever human beings are transformed into problems to be solved rather than neighbours to be known.


In recent years, South Africa has once again witnessed a rise in anti-immigrant sentiment. Foreign nationals are routinely blamed for unemployment, crime and failing public services. Faced with complex social and economic challenges, it is often easier to point to visible outsiders than to confront more difficult realities. Yet what I find particularly striking is how little legality seems to matter. Public debates often suggest that the issue is documentation, that hostility is directed only at those who lack the proper papers. Yet lived experience tells a different story. Refugees carrying valid permits, students lawfully enrolled at universities and long-term residents who have spent years contributing to their communities often find themselves subjected to the same suspicion. Recent anti-immigrant campaigns and protests have only reinforced this reality, demonstrating how quickly legal status can become irrelevant once a person is marked as an outsider.  The issue, it seems, is no longer legality. The issue is belonging.


When I was younger, I believed documents had power. Adults treated them as though they did. Passports were carefully stored. Permits were renewed. Birth certificates were tucked away in drawers and folders. Documents opened doors, crossed borders and settled questions. Or so I thought. As I grew older, I realised that documents answer only certain kinds of questions. They can tell people where you were born. They can confirm your legal status. They can prove that you are permitted to be somewhere. What they cannot do is convince someone that you belong. That lesson reveals itself in small moments: a question asked with just enough suspicion to make you uncomfortable, a joke that everyone else laughs at, the pause that follows your …

author: Nelly Madegwa
title: Faith, Power, and Paradox in Kenya’s Church
content:
“The Church must not move so close to the state, because you can get burned. The state is like fire. But the Church must also not stay very far from it, because you might feel a lot of cold.” That warning was passed down to Bishop Charles Ong’injo, of the Anglican Church of Kenya’s Maseno South Diocese, by a former archbishop. Balancing that closeness is difficult, he told me. But he was clear about where the danger has historically come from. “Each time the Church has felt very comfortable with the state, then you realize that people suffer,” he said. “If you read the history of revolutions in the world, be it the French Revolution or any other, you realize it was sometimes triggered by the comfort the Church was enjoying from the state.” Get too close to the fire, in other words, and it is not only the Church that gets burned.


I grew up believing the Church was where you went to learn how to live right. I did not expect it would also be where I would learn how easily “living right” could mean staying quiet.


Matthew 10:30 tells us that even the hairs on our head are numbered, a reminder of how closely God is meant to care about our lives. So, church leaders should care about the finance bills that have left many of us drowning in debt, unable to feed, clothe, or house ourselves. They should care that we cannot access healthcare because money meant for hospitals has been misappropriated, or afford school because public money is tied up in corruption scandals that will likely never be resolved.


I eventually found myself in a place I never wanted to be; I did not want to leave my faith, but I also could not remain in the Church. I have seen the sneer on people’s faces when they hear the comment, “I love God, I practise my faith, I just don’t go to church.” I understand. It’s been hard to do one without the other. I hate that I had to leave the Church and try to practise my faith outside of it. But how could I sit and listen to people who did not seem to care about my daily struggles, not as abstract issues, but as things I was actually living through?


I don’t have a roadmap for this. I have felt lost more times than I liked, but there’s still something there.


I do not know how this fits into my journey toward heaven later. With all of this sitting in me, I wanted to talk to someone who had chosen the harder side of that warning rather than simply theorize about it.


If the Church is meant to be close enough to society to know when people are hurting, what is it supposed to do when the country itself is in crisis? Kenya has been living through protests, abductions, and endless corruption scandals. “I think the role of the Church remains constant whether the country is in crisis or not,” Bishop Ong’injo said, “because the Church is the conscience of society. It must constantly remind its citizenry that they have a responsibility to be each other’s keeper, to ensure the rule of law, because our constitution gets its strength from God’s laws. When we are in a crisis, the Church must add its voice to all the other voices championing for justice.”


If the Church was supposed to be society’s conscience, then silence was not neutral. I shared with Bishop Ong’injo what I had noticed in my own church; leaders remaining silent while congregants grew frustrated enough to call them out. Was the burden of demanding a just and fair country ours alone, or did it belong to the people leading us, too? “Spiritual leadership entails that, first of all, you are standing in the gap,” he said, “and a spiritual leader is supposed to stand in the gap between human beings and God. Like the old biblical prophets, they are supposed to warn, warning of the dangers when we are not doing the correct thing. It can be very catastrophic, and therefore, they are not supposed to be reminded by their congregants of what to do, because they are supposed to be listening to the voice of God.”


Bishop Ong’injo illustrated this role with the image of the watchman. “The watchman might not be a soldier who will fight the enemy, but the watchman is supposed to warn that where you are standing is dangerous. The enemy is coming. Can you take cover? And, therefore, sometimes we may not do much, but we must shout like the watchman, because that is what we are called to do. You must warn people that you are in a dangerous situation. Just the way every Sunday we preach against sin, because it destroys life. I think that is a critical role that the Church …

author: Mzi Velapi
title: ‘Like ICE’: Western Cape police accused of unlawfully detaining foreign migrants
content:
Up to 200 foreign migrants have been in detained by the police since the 30

th

 of June as part of the state response to the anti-immigration protests led by March and March and Operation Dudula. The Inter-Ministerial Committee on Migration declared even before the xenophobic deadline that the arrest of “illegal foreign nationals” would be intensified.


The Western Cape Coalition Against Xenophobia (WCC-AX) is raising the alarm over the conduct of the South African Police Service in Robertson and surrounding towns, which it likens to that of the Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency (ICE) of the United States of America. ICE is is carrying out the Trump administration’s mass deportation campaign, often arresting migrants in public places and immigration offices. They have killed 8 immigrants and protesters this year, with over 50 detainees dying since 2025.


WCC-AX say that the rights of the migrants have been trampled upon as they languish in jail in Robertson and surrounding Winelands towns, denied medication, their basic sanitary requirements, and food. They are all from our neighbouring states, mostly Zimbabwe, and Malawi, Mozambique and Lesotho.


The Robertson police denied these claims and said food brought by relatives and supporters of the detainees has been allowed, but access has to be managed. “The station commander has confirmed that food brought by relatives is permitted, subject to a controlled process, and that visits are allowed but managed due to the large number of family members seeking access to detainees,” said the police.


But the police are not managing the acceptance of goods as it is arbitrary, with some police officers refusing and others being sympathetic to the plight of the detainees, WCC-AX responded. “The acceptance of goods,  including medication, has been totally arbitrary, with some police simply refusing to accept items, going so far as to say they ‘don’t care’, while other police have acknowledged this pattern and acted differently, but all entirely at their own discretion apparently.”


Sheriff Ramaobi, an activist in the area, confirmed that they were told that they cannot bring anything to the detainees. “One of our colleagues who visited one of the prison cells in Robertson asked these questions in terms of, can we bring medication or food supplies to our migrant brothers and sisters?  And it was denied. Other police stations, like McGregor and Montagu, strictly said that we’re not allowed. We are not allowed to give any support to the people that are incarcerated,” she said.


The police also deny that the detainees have been kept in jail illegally, saying that they have acted within the law and in cooperation with the Department of Home Affairs. “The foreign nationals detained for immigration-related purposes are dealt with in terms of the applicable legislation and in cooperation with the Department of Home Affairs, which is responsible for immigration administration and deportation processes,” said SAPS.


WCC-AX disputes this, saying that after they paid the admission-of-guilt fines, they were supposed to be released and not kept in jail for over two months. “If the police wanted to continue to detain them, they should have followed the administrative procedures laid down in s34 of the Immigration Act. The law states that people have to be told why they are being detained and what their rights are, including their right to challenge the deportation decision and to legal representation. Their continued detention must come before a court with them getting the opportunity to make representations. This did not happen. That’s why their continued detention is unlawful,” WCC-AX argues.


Anti-immigrant protesters outside the provincial legislature in Cape Town on the 30

th

 of June. File photo by Mzi Velapi


WCC-AX demands


The key demands of the Western Cape Coalition Against Xenophobia include the release of the detainees, for SAPS members to “stop acting like members of March and March (and ICE in the US)”, and act within the law.


The anti-xenophobia group is also calling for the suspension of police officers accused of failing to enforce the law and human rights violations, and that they must be subjected to an inquiry. The South African Human Rights Commission must also conduct an investigation. “The minister of home affairs must explain why his departmental officials conflate criminal and administrative proceedings in contravention of the Immigration Act,” …

author: Hassan Alnaser, Mohamed Alagra, Mashair Idris
title: Sudan Nashra: Hemedti in Addis Ababa | Buildup at Ethiopian base fuels concerns over RSF corridor toward Blue Nile capital, military sends massive reinforcements | RSF fortifies West Darfur capital with berms, reinforces troops | RSF commander in North Kordofan defects, arrives in capital with 200 fighters
content:
Subscribe to our Lens on Sudan newsletter


here

.


When Rapid Support Forces Commander Mohamed Hamdan “Hemedti” Dagalo quietly touched down in Addis Ababa last week, the Blue Nile State front was raging along Ethiopia’s border and reinforcements for the fighting were amassing on both sides. Ethiopia, meanwhile, was contending with renewed tensions of its own. 


For the RSF, keeping channels open with Addis Ababa is particularly important given that its border is part of the security environment surrounding the fighting in Blue Nile. Operations and troop movements along the border were among the main subjects of Hemedti’s talks, according to an RSF leadership source and an Ethiopian government source who spoke to Mada Masr. For the Ethiopian source, Addis Ababa’s immediate concern is keeping Sudan’s war from spilling across the border.


But Sudanese intelligence sees another layer to Ethiopia’s interest in the RSF. Ethiopia could factor the paramilitary group into its own military arrangements as it manages conflicts with domestic opponents, particularly amid renewed tensions with Tigray, a Sudanese intelligence source said. Such a relationship could also give Addis Ababa greater room to operate on the Sudanese side of the border, they added.


The Sudanese military is watching that possibility from an increasingly exposed position. It has lost the strategic border towns of Geisan and Kurmuk in Blue Nile and is now trying to stop the advance from the border toward Blue Nile’s capital, Damazin.


And there is a new reason for concern — a significant buildup since July at an Ethiopian military base in

Asosa, located in the Benishangul-Gumuz region bordering Sudan.

 The area has been repeatedly used to launch major operations by the RSF and its allies into Blue Nile. But an intelligence source in the state said the recent buildup could make the cross-border corridor into Kurmuk and Geisan harder for the military to penetrate and could facilitate the unimpeded movement of supplies and forces to the RSF and its allies.


With the border towns secured, the RSF and its allies are now pushing against the military positions guarding Damazin. They captured Bakori in the Geisan locality and Sirkum in Kurmuk last week, triggering a rush of military reinforcements into the state capital and the positions around it.


While the military is shoring up Damazin, the RSF is fortifying Geneina, the capital of West Darfur. Military operations this week secured another position near the city, part of an offensive that has been underway since July and has brought military and allied forces within reach of the RSF-held capital. 


The RSF is now digging around the city, extending sand berms and trenches as a defensive measure against a possible surprise attack. This week, it brought in large numbers of fighters in what a military field source described as preparation for attacks on military positions in West Darfur and neighboring North Darfur.


Kordofan, the war’s critical faultline between an RSF push east and a military push west, saw its second major defection this week. Abu Bakr Dahloub, the RSF’s intelligence chief for special missions in North Kordofan’s Hamra al-Sheikh and the Egypt-Libya-Sudan border triangle, defected to the military with around 200 fighters.


After securing major gains in North Kordofan weeks ago, the military continues to target RSF supply and gathering points in neighboring West Kordofan. Military aircraft struck several fuel and ammunition depots and RSF gatherings there this week, destroying supplies that had just arrived to reinforce positions in the area. 


In Khartoum, the state is trying to get its internal political dialogue off the ground despite intractable disagreements with major political forces over the process itself. The dialogue’s preparatory committee announced its formation this week and is now beginning outreach. But ongoing disputes over the committee’s independence, the fact that talks will be held in military-controlled territory and the question of who gets a seat at the table remain major obstacles to its efforts to secure participation.

Hemedti in Addis Ababa


In his second trip to the Ethiopian capital since the war broke out, RSF Commander Mohamed Hamdan “Hemedti” Dagalo arrived in Addis Ababa in an unannounced visit on August 26.
